component.name: Foyer Studio
component.summary: Web-native control surface for the Ardour DAW

description.p: Foyer Studio replaces the DAW's UI with one built on modern browser capabilities: tiling and floating windows, schema-driven plugin panels, keyboard-first commands, and remote collaboration over WebSocket. The audio engine is a bundled Ardour, running natively against your hardware through PipeWire's JACK layer — true low-latency sound with none of the container friction.
Open the desktop window for a native experience, or point any browser (phones included) at the embedded server to control the same session from across the room.
First flatpak-packaged build: bundled Ardour, PipeWire/JACK hardware passthrough, native desktop shell.
